title: The Dabbling Duck Charters
specs: Experienced captains with US Coast Guard Master Captain licenses
Boat has bimini tops for shade
includes: Storage space for coolers and towels
blurb: Guests take chartered pontoon boat trips on Center Hill Lake to visit waterfalls, swim, and enjoy sunset cruises. Excursions last approximately 2-3 hours and include at least 1 hour of swimming or viewing at the waterfall. The boats have bimini tops for shade and life vests in various sizes are provided.
extraNote: No refunds unless captain cancels due to dangerous weather conditions · Captain determines if weather is charterable; light rain and passing storms usually allowed · Rescheduling is always an option if weather is uncharterable · Cookeville Boat Dock Marina, slip number 1009, Baxter, Tennessee. Park on the left side of the lot near the marina. · 2026 season runs as long as water levels allow access to the falls
